Translating business and operational priorities into technical strategies and cross-architecture solutions that deliver measurable outcomes. Engaging new lines of business and key customer stakeholders to uncover emerging priorities, expand Cisco’s relevance and identify opportunities for cross-architecture solutions. Leading customer conversations around AI strategy and AI-ready infrastructure, connecting data center, networking, security, observability and automation capabilities to evolving AI use cases and business outcomes. Collaborating with global and regional account teams to develop account strategies, identify opportunities and advance key customer engagements across the Americas. Leading technical discovery, architectural design, presentations, demonstrations, workshops and proof-of-concept activities. Positioning Cisco’s differentiation, business value and developing competitive technical strategies to build customer confidence and preference for Future-Proofed Workplaces, AI-Ready Data Centers and Digital Resilience solutions. Coordinating specialists, BEs, partners and CX resources to provide a seamless experience throughout the sales cycle. Representing customer priorities within Cisco and maintaining strategic relationships with Business Entities, engineering, services and support teams to influence roadmaps and improve customer outcomes. Maintaining expertise across Cisco technologies, particularly AI and Service Provider solutions, and using industry trends, competitive insights and AI-enabled tools to provide informed customer recommendations. Minimum Qualifications 7+ years of experience in solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, technical consulting or a comparable customer-facing technology role. Experience leading technical discovery, solution-design presentations, demonstrations, workshops or POC activities for large enterprise customers. Experience translating customer business priorities into technical strategies and engaging with senior and executive stakeholders. Ability to travel within the Americas and participate in global customer or team meetings across time zones, based on business requirements. Preferred Qualifications Cisco certification such as CCIE or an equivalent industry-recognized technical certification. BS/BA (EE/CS) or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience designing and positioning AI-ready infrastructure, including data center networking, compute connectivity, security, observability or automation capabilities that support AI workloads. Technical expertise in Service Provider technologies and routing, including experience with large-scale IP/MPLS networks, segment routing, network automation or comparable architectures. Experience supporting multiple large and complex global enterprise environments involving multiple stakeholders, locations or technology domains. Ability to support multiple large global enterprise accounts and communicate complex technical strategies as clear business outcomes across cultures, functions and geographic regions. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time. U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies: 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations) 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies. Employees On Sales Plans Earn Performance-based Incentive Pay On Top Of Their Base Salary, Which Is Split Between Quota And Non-quota Components, Subject To The Applicable Cisco Plan. For Quota-based Incentive Pay, Cisco Typically Pays As Follows .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota; 1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%; 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation. new_matches.title: Nätverksspecialist inom transmission och IP
new_matches.description: Transmission | Radiolänk | Fiber och optik | IP-nätverk Har du erfarenhet av transmission eller radiolänk och vill bredda dig inom IP? Du har praktisk erfarenhet av transmission, radiolänk, fiber, optik eller närliggande telekominfrastruktur och vill ta ett större tekniskt ansvar. Nu söker vi en Nätverksspecialist inom transmission och IP till FMTIS i Örebro. Tyngdpunkten ligger från början på transmission och radiolänk. Du förbereder, konfigurerar, kvalitetssäkrar och driftsätter robusta kommunikationslösningar. Med tiden får du även bredda din kompetens inom IP, routing och switching. Du behöver inte vara specialist inom alla områden. Det viktiga är att du kan bidra självständigt inom transmission eller radiolänk och vill utvecklas i gränslandet mellan fysisk kommunikationsinfrastruktur och IP. Varför den här rollen? Här får du arbeta med hela kommunikationskedjan – från radiolänk, fiber och optik till den IP-baserade kommunikationen. Lösningarna ska vara säkra, tillgängliga och robusta även när kraven är höga. Rollen är mer kvalificerad än installation och löpande drift. Du tar tekniskt ansvar från konfigurering och kontroll till driftsättning och dokumenterad överlämning. Samtidigt utvecklar du en bred och eftertraktad kompetens inom både transmission och IP. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Som Nätverksspecialist skapar du de tekniska förutsättningarna för nya och förändrade kommunikationslösningar. Du samverkar med interna tekniker och externa leverantörer vid etablering och förändring av nätverksplatser och konfigurerar kommunikationsutrustning, ofta på distans från kontoret. Du genomför tekniska kontroller, kvalitetssäkrar och medverkar vid driftsättning. När lösningen är klar dokumenterar och lämnar du över den till driftorganisationen. Driften ansvarar därefter för löpande drift och övervakning, medan du ger specialiststöd vid mer komplexa fel. new_matches.description: At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. Across Southeast Asia we reach that infrastructure through partners: distributors, systems integrators, managed service providers and industrial automation firms. The Channel Solution Architect makes those partners technically capable of finding, qualifying and positioning Dragos, and of supporting Dragos-led evaluations on the ground. The role is the technical authority behind the regional partner ecosystem, working alongside the Channel Account Manager who owns the commercial relationship. Responsibilities Enabling partner technical sellers Making partner pre-sales and technical staff capable of opening and advancing Dragos opportunities without a Dragos engineer in every conversation. Qualification. Partners can identify a genuine OT security opportunity, ask the right discovery questions in an industrial environment, and disqualify early where there is no fit. Positioning. Partners can articulate the Dragos value proposition credibly to both OT and security audiences and hold their own against competing vendors. Demonstration. Partners can deliver a Dragos demo confidently and answer the technical questions that follow. Sizing inputs. Partners know what information to collect from a customer environment for solution sizing: site count, network architecture, protocol mix, asset volumes and collection points. They gather the inputs. Dragos designs the solution. Enabling partner field resources to support evaluations Proofs of value and proofs of concept are led and designed by a Dragos Solution Architect. Partner field engineers provide local execution during those evaluations, working to the Dragos design. The Channel Solution Architect makes them capable of doing that accurately. Installing evaluation sensors and appliances to a Dragos-specified design, including physical placement, cabling and network connection. Local logistics, site access, scheduling and on-site coordination for the duration of the evaluation. Working accurately to a Dragos-authored evaluation plan and escalating correctly when site conditions differ from what the design assumed. Safe removal and handback of evaluation equipment at the close of the engagement. Building the enablement programme Design and maintain the certification pathway and curriculum for both partner audiences across the four priority markets. Deliver enablement directly where the working language allows and develop partner trainers where local-language delivery is required. Build reusable technical assets: demo scripts, sizing guides, reference architectures and competitive positioning material for Southeast Asian verticals and regulatory contexts. Track partner certification currency and technical readiness and advise the Channel Account Manager on partner technical capability. Supporting the field Provide technical support to partner-sourced opportunities during qualification. Coach partner sellers in live customer situations, building capability rather than taking over. Act as the technical escalation point for partners across the region. Feed regional technical requirements and field observations back to Product and Product Marketing. Qualifications Demonstrated experience working with channel partners (Value Added Resellers, Global System Integrators, OEMs, technology partners, etc.), with a strong understanding of enterprise software partnering strategies, procurement processes, and best practices to effectively drive sales and build relationships. At least 3 years of experience in a pre-sales or solution architecture experience in a technical product environment, with the ability to run a credible technical conversation with both engineers and security leaders. At least 5 years of experience in cybersecurity. Familiarity with OT and exposure to Industrial verticals like oil and gas, power, water, mining or manufacturing. Strong technical background, including network architecture and passive monitoring and collection design. Strong skills in presentation, relationship building, and negotiation. Experience enabling others, whether through partner enablement, technical training or team development. Comfort operating across Southeast Asian markets and working with engineering and integration firms as well as IT security resellers. Willingness to travel across the region regularly, up to 50%. All new hires must pass a background check as a condition of employment.

new_matches.title: Supply Chain and Manufacturing AI Product Engineer
new_matches.description: Job Description We are seeking an energetic and technically sharp Junior Forward Deployed AI Engineer to support the rapid prototyping, discovery, and proof-of-concept (PoC) delivery of AI-powered solutions across our global Supply Chain and Manufacturing functions. This is a dynamic, fast-paced role where you will work alongside senior engineers to bridge the gap between AI development and real-world shop floor operations. You will spend time embedding directly with frontline teams—visiting manufacturing sites and warehouses—to understand their day-to-day challenges, and then turn those insights into working, AI-enabled software prototypes. The ideal candidate is a proactive builder who is comfortable working with Python, eager to learn cutting-edge GenAI frameworks, and excited about collaborating directly with operational business teams. Key Responsibilities Frontline Engagement & Discovery Frontline Shadowing: Participate in site visits and shadow frontline teams (Logistics, Manufacturing, Procurement) to understand operational bottlenecks first-hand. Requirements Translation: Support senior engineers in translating user feedback and "messy" real-world problems into structured user stories, functional specs, and process flows. Active Scrum Participant: Maintain and update the team's agile backlog, actively participate in daily standups, and assist in coordinating sprint planning. Rapid AI Prototyping & Development Hands-on Coding: Write clean, documented, and functional Python code to build, refine, and test AI-enabled prototypes. Support RAG & Agentic Systems: Work under the guidance of senior engineers to construct and tune Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, semantic search indices, and multi-agent system workflows. Iterate & Refine: Actively modify prototypes based on immediate feedback from factory floor workers and warehouse operators. Adopt Best Practices: Learn and apply enterprise software development standards to ensure prototype code is structured for eventual production handoff. Systems Integration & Data Engineering API Configuration: Assist in building and configuring APIs to connect AI applications to shop floor platforms (e.g., Poka, Weaver) and document repositories. Data Wrangling: Clean, structure, and prepare unstructured documents, telemetry feeds, and SQL database exports for ingestion into AI systems. Typical Use Cases Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Assistants designed to help operators look up technical guidelines hands-free. Manufacturing Knowledge Assistants that index equipment manuals to speed up machine maintenance. Procurement Intelligence Tools that extract and summarize key terms from supplier contracts. Workflow Automation Tools to help administrative logistics teams auto-generate shift handover reports. Career Growth This role will be an excellent fit for someone who: Enjoys solving varied, real-world problems. Likes interacting with customers and understanding business needs. Wants to work on cutting-edge AI applications rather than purely research. Thrives in fast-paced environments where you own projects from design to deployment. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience: 1–3 years of professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, or digital technology delivery. Coding Foundation: Robust baseline experience writing Python (Pandas, NumPy, requests) and a strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals (OOP, REST APIs). AI Familiarity: Hands-on experience (which can include academic projects, bootcamps, or personal portfolios) using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini) and basic RAG architectures. Data Skills: Proficient with SQL and comfortable querying relational databases. Soft Skills & Mobility: Excellent communication skills with the confidence to converse with factory operators. Highly curious, eager to learn, and willing to travel occasionally to manufacturing facilities. Preferred Qualifications Basic experience with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph. Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform/Vertex AI, Microsoft Azure). Familiarity with version control (Git/GitHub) and containerization (Docker). Academic background or brief exposure to Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or Logistics environments. Success Measures Technical Growth: Rapid ramp-up on advanced enterprise AI architectures and frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Vertex AI). Prototype Delivery Velocity: Successfully completing assigned development tasks within the sprint cycle. User-Centric Execution: Translating frontline operator feedback into functional code modifications. #TBdigital

new_matches.description: Senior Platform Engineer (GitHub Migration Specialist) Remote About Us Modus Create is a digital consulting partner that helps ambitious organizations design, build, and modernize digital products, platforms, and AI-powered experiences. We work shoulder-to-shoulder with client teams to move from idea to production quickly and sustainably, with a clear path to scale. Founded in 2011, Modus is a global, fully remote team of world-class technologists who thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment. We're a digital product engineering partner for forward-thinking businesses. Our global teams work side-by-side with clients to design, build, and scale custom solutions that achieve real results and lasting change, partnering with industry leaders including AWS, GitHub, and Atlassian. We were fully remote before it was cool! Recognized as one of the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies for nine years and a top remote work company by FlexJobs, we have helped some of the world's largest brands deliver powerful digital experiences. Opportunity Modus Create is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to lead high-impact strategic consulting and full-lifecycle product development. In this role, you will partner with cross-functional teams to modernize infrastructure and drive complex cloud-native migrations, with a specific focus on transitioning enterprise scale workloads to GitHub Enterprise Cloud (GHEC). Requirements 7+ years of experience with cloud-native platform migrations, moving workloads to modern compute, storage, and auth primitives. Proven expertise in GitHub Enterprise Cloud (GHEC) migrations, specifically using GitHub Enterprise Importer (GEI) and managing Enterprise Managed Users (EMU). Experience building and maintaining scalable, reliable platform services. Expertise in managing the full lifecycle of internal developer platforms (IDP). Understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud-native architecture principles. Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred) and deep comfort with distributed systems, platform APIs, and cloud-native design. Proficiency in CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and HashiCorp tooling. Strong automation skills in Python, bash, or alternatively Powershell; solid understanding of modern delivery practices including AI-powered SDLC and agentic tooling. Excellent communication and problem-solving skills; ability to mentor client teams and work independently with minimal direction. Key Responsibilities & Deliverables Migrate all repositories, user accounts, and access controls to a new, secure GitHub Enterprise Cloud (GHEC) instance with Enterprise Managed Users (EMU) and Data Residency. Establish a governed EMU environment with centralized Identity and Access Management (IAM). Use GitHub Enterprise Importer (GEI) to migrate repositories and workflows, preserving full Git history, branch protections, and metadata. Transition from individual repository permissions to scalable, team-based access synced with the identity provider. Validate all integrations and dependent toolchains prior to cutover to ensure operational continuity. Deliver a fully documented, governed environment in handoff. Design and maintain robust infrastructure platforms that empower engineering teams to deliver software efficiently. Standardize platform tooling, ensuring consistency and reliability across environments. Develop and support self-service capabilities for infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to streamline development workflows. Team Collaboration: Overlap with EST business hours daily is expected Reliable high-speed internet is a must Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with client IT teams and internal Modus engagement leadership Bonus Skills GitHub certifications Azure certifications AWS certifications You’ll Love Lead High-Stakes Migrations: Own the strategy and execution of complex GHEC migrations. Implement Enterprise Governance: Design secure, compliant environments using Enterprise Managed Users (EMU). Modernize DevOps: Use GitHub Actions, CI/CD, and IaC to build efficient, automated workflows. Drive Impact: Partner with IT leadership to deliver production-ready environments that accelerate client development. Join a Global Team: Work with a collaborative, remote-first squad of experts dedicated to engineering excellence. By joining our team, you’ll be part of a winning squad that plays to each other’s strengths and celebrates every success together.

new_matches.title: UN Women, Consultant(e) national(e) en charge de l’évaluation de la participation des jeunes filles et femmes aux filières industrielles de l’enseignement technique en Côte d’Ivoire
new_matches.description: Job Description Background: L’Agence des Nations Unies pour l’égalité genre et l’autonomisation des femmes, ONU Femmes, met en œuvre un triple mandat normatif, de coordination et opérationnel, en défendant les normes en matière d'égalité des sexes et d'autonomisation des femmes. ONU Femmes transforme la vision des objectifs de développement durable en une réalité pour les femmes et les filles, soutenant la participation égale des femmes dans tous les aspects de la vie. ONU Femmes met en relation des acteurs mondiaux, nationaux et locaux pour créer un environnement favorable, en travaillant avec les gouvernements et la société civile pour concevoir des lois, des politiques, des programmes et des services visant à garantir que les normes définies bénéficient réellement aux femmes et aux filles du monde entier. L'Agence s'efforce d'identifier et de démanteler les obstacles structurels en la matière et les relations de pouvoir inégales, y compris les lois, les politiques et les pratiques discriminatoires. Au cours des deux dernières décennies, la Côte d’Ivoire a réalisé des progrès significatifs en matière d’accès à l’éducation, portés notamment par la Politique de Scolarisation Obligatoire et les réformes successives du secteur Éducation-Formation. Ces avancées ont permis d’atteindre des niveaux élevés de scolarisation au primaire et de renforcer le cadre institutionnel du système éducatif. Toutefois, ces progrès restent marqués par des inégalités structurelles de parcours qui affectent de manière disproportionnée les filles et les femmes. Ces inégalités ne se traduisent plus principalement par une absence totale de scolarisation, mais par des ruptures progressives et cumulatives tout au long du continuum éducatif, en particulier lors des transitions entre le primaire, le secondaire et la formation professionnelle. Dans ce contexte, l’enseignement technique et professionnel apparaît comme un levier stratégique indispensable pour offrir des trajectoires pouvant garantir l’autonomisation économique des jeunes filles et femmes de Côte d’Ivoire. La Côte d’Ivoire, dans son plan national de développement (2026-2030) vise dans son pilier stratégique 4 le développement du capital humain, des compétences et création d’emplois décents. Ce pilier vise à contribuer plus efficacement au développement économique et social à travers le développement d’un système éducatif performant intégrant les principes de l’économie circulaire, le renforcement de l’employabilité des jeunes et création d’emplois décents, la promotion de l’adéquation compétence-emploi, l’amélioration de la santé et du bien-être des populations, le renforcement de la sécurité nutritionnelle et le renforcement de l’inclusion sociale. Toutefois, la participation des femmes et des filles aux filières industrielles, qui constituent pourtant des trajectoires vers des secteurs clés de création d’emplois et de transformation économique, est limitée. Selon les données nationales, les filles ne représentaient qu’environ 18 % des effectifs dans les filières industrielles en 2023, alors que le Plan National de Développement (PND) 2026-2030 ambitionne de porter cette proportion à 30 % à l’horizon 2030. En vue de renforcer la participation des filles dans les filières industrielles (Génie Industriel et Bâtiment, Nouvelles Technologies et autres) tout en assurant leur insertion professionnelle ainsi que leur bien-être, il est nécessaire d’analyser, de manière intégrée, les obstacles structurels, institutionnels, pédagogiques et socio-culturels qui entravent la participation et l’insertion professionnelles des filles et des femmes aux filières industrielles, à évaluer les mesures correctives existantes et à identifier les leviers stratégiques susceptibles d’améliorer leur participation tout en garantissant leur insertion professionnelle et autonomisation économique. A cet effet, ONU Femmes recrute un consultant national qui sera chargé de réaliser une évaluation de l’environnement de formation et la participation des jeunes filles et femmes aux filières industrielles de l’enseignement technique en Côte d’Ivoire afin d’Identifier les barrières et blocages puis de proposer des recommandations visant à améliorer l'accès, la rétention, et l'insertion professionnelle des jeunes filles et femmes de Côte d’Ivoire. Le/la consultant(e) travaillera sous la supervision générale de la Représentante Résidente et la supervision technique de la coordonnatrice de projet WEE. Il/Elle sera assisté (e) par l’assistante programme autonomisation économique des femmes, qui sera le point focal pour les questions de contrat et de paiement. Description Of Responsibilities/ Scope Of Work Analyser, de manière intégrée, les obstacles structurels, institutionnels, pédagogiques, socio-économiques et socio-culturels qui entravent la participation des filles et des femmes aux filières industrielles de l’enseignement technique et professionnel en Côte d’Ivoire ; Évaluer la prise en compte de l’égalité de genre dans les curricula, référentiels de formation, contenus pédagogiques, méthodes d’enseignement et supports didactiques, ainsi que les éventuels stéréotypes de genre ; Analyser l’environnement d’apprentissage des filles, notamment les conditions en classe, dans les ateliers et laboratoires, l’accès aux équipements et aux travaux pratiques, ainsi que les relations entre apprenantes, enseignants et personnel d’encadrement ; Identifier et analyser les opportunités dans les secteurs porteurs y compris le numérique, la technologie, les mines et l’économie verte en lien avec les besoins du marché du travail et les perspectives d’emploi en Côte d’Ivoire; Proposer des recommandations visant à créer les conditions favorables pour la participation des jeunes filles et femmes aux filières industrielles de l’enseignement technique et professionnels, renforcer leur accès et rétention et garantir leur employabilité/auto emploi en vue de contribuer à leur autonomisation économique ; Organiser un atelier de validation des résultats et recommandations avec l’ensemble des acteurs clés de l’écosystème ; Elaborer un document de projet visant à renforcer la participation des jeunes filles et femmes aux filières industrielles ainsi que leur autonomisation économique Délivrables Un diagnostic des obstacles structurels, institutionnels, pédagogiques, socio-économiques et socio-culturels qui entravent la participation des filles et des femmes aux filières industrielles de l’enseignement technique et professionnel en Côte d’Ivoire incluant les aspects liés aux curricula, aux conditions d’apprentissage, à l’environnement professionnel etc. ; Un rapport final de l’étude présentant les axes clés d’intervention qui permettront d’améliorer la participation, la rétention des jeunes filles et femmes aux filières industrielles ainsi que leur insertion professionnelle et comprenant les principaux constats et recommandations issus de l’évaluation ; new_matches.title: Senior Director
new_matches.description: Senior Director, Executive Search Remote - Texas, Georgia, Minnesota, South Carolina, North Carolina About Maneva Group Maneva Group is a women- and minority-owned national executive search firm that partners with mission-driven organizations to place bold, values-aligned leaders. We are committed to advancing meaningful change and positive impact through every engagement, championing leadership that inspires progress and empowers organizations to thrive. Our clients include renowned national nonprofits, cultural institutions, community development organizations, education leaders, civic movements, and foundations. From fighting human trafficking to rebuilding Black Wall Street to elevating mental health services, we are proud to support transformative leadership in the sectors that shape society. Maneva is a rapidly growing, entrepreneurial, and innovative firm built around relationships, exceptional client service, and a genuine commitment to our mission. We are building a collaborative and high-performing team that cares deeply about both the quality of our work and the people behind it. For more information, please visit manevagroup.com . About the Role: The Director is a key member of Maneva's search team, helping support the execution of executive searches from the first conversations with a client through the successful placement of a new leader. This is not a business development role, and is ideal for a senior talent professional who loves the execution side of search. This is a highly collaborative, client-facing role for someone who loves the intersection of people, strategy, research, storytelling, and project leadership. On any given day, you might be learning the intricacies of a rare disease organization, helping a board articulate what it needs in its next CEO, interviewing an accomplished executive, developing a creative sourcing strategy, or helping a client navigate an important hiring decision. Working closely with Maneva's Partners and Search Leads, the Director will manage multiple executive search engagements and take meaningful ownership of the search process. You will translate what you hear from clients into a compelling leadership profile and search strategy, build and assess strong candidate pipelines, develop thoughtful client deliverables, and create an exceptional experience for candidates and clients alike. We want someone who is curious, thoughtful, proactive, and willing to bring ideas to the table - someone who can see around corners, recognize when a search needs to shift, and help the team determine the best path forward. As Maneva continues to grow, so will this role. The Director will have increasing opportunities to lead search strategy, deepen client relationships, mentor other members of the team, contribute to the firm's growth, and ultimately develop toward independently leading executive search engagements. Key Responsibilities Lead exceptional executive searches: Manage the day-to-day leadership of multiple retained searches, keeping the team aligned, anticipating what comes next, and ensuring every engagement moves forward with thoughtfulness, urgency, and care. Understand what great leadership looks like: Listen deeply to executives, board members, staff, and other stakeholders to understand an organization's strategy, culture, opportunities, and challenges - and translate those insights into a clear leadership profile and search strategy. Candidate development: Develop creative sourcing strategies and build strong, diverse candidate pools through research, networking, outreach, referrals, and market intelligence. Proactively engage passive candidates through direct calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn outreach, and targeted relationship-building. Look beyond the obvious candidate and make connections across organizations, sectors, and experiences. Assess executive talent: Interview and evaluate senior leaders, digging beyond the resume to understand leadership competencies, accomplishments, motivations, career decisions, and fit with a client's needs. Exercise judgment about which candidates should move forward and communicate those insights through compelling candidate assessments. Advise and engage clients: Serve as a trusted day-to-day partner to clients throughout the search. Lead portions of client meetings, present candidates and market insights, synthesize feedback, and help clients navigate decisions throughout the process. Create a standout candidate and client experience: Build trusted relationships and ensure that candidates and clients experience Maneva as responsive, thoughtful, transparent, and deeply invested in their success. Bring strategy to the process: Help design interview processes, assessment tools, candidate presentations, position profiles, and other materials that enable clients to make thoughtful and informed hiring decisions. Leadership Style & Personal Characteristics The ideal candidate embodies both heart and hustle, bringing a blend of administrative strength, strong interpersonal skills, and alignment with Maneva’s values. While no single candidate will bring every competency, strong candidates will see themselves reflected in the following characteristics: Entrepreneurial and Service-Oriented: You take initiative, spot opportunities, and think creatively; all while leading with a genuine desire to help clients, candidates, and teammates succeed. Detail-Oriented and Organized: You have a sharp eye for details and are energized by juggling multiple tasks, timelines, and deliverables across several projects. Clear Communicator: You write and speak with clarity, professionalism, and warmth, and can adapt your tone for different audiences. Technology Forward: You’re comfortable exploring and adopting emerging tools, including AI, to work smarter and more efficiently, and you adapt quickly as technology evolves. Collaborative and Kind: You enjoy working on a team, are open to feedback, and bring a generous spirit to your work and relationships. Curious and Resourceful: You’re a natural researcher and a problem-solver. You enjoy figuring things out, making connections, and learning about different sectors and organizations. Mission-Aligned: You care deeply about social impact, positive change, and are excited to support organizations and communities working to uplift people and empower progress. Design-Savvy (a plus): You don’t need to be a graphic designer, but if you have an eye for layout, aesthetics, or familiarity with tools like Canva or Adobe, that’s a bonus. Why Join Maneva? At Maneva, we believe in the power of leadership to spark innovation, drive change, and make the world a better place. Our name, Maneva, comes from the combination of two Sanskrit words: “ Mānav ” meaning mankind, & “ Sevā ” meaning service. We are driven by the ideal of our name - service to humanity. You’ll join a firm that is entrepreneurial in spirit, deeply values-driven, and rooted in strong relationships. We offer a unique opportunity to: Make a Difference: Every search we lead is about impact. You’ll help organizations that are creating positive change find the right leader at pivotal moments in their evolution - leaders who reflect and serve their communities. Grow with Intention: As a growing firm, we invest in the development of our team. You’ll gain hands-on experience across all aspects of executive search, with opportunities to grow your skills in research, strategy, storytelling, and client service. Work Flexibly: We’re a remote-first team that values flexibility and trust. We care about outcomes and collaboration, not where you work from. Be Part of a Team That Cares: We are kind, high-performing, and mission-aligned. We challenge each other to do great work while supporting one another along the way. And we bring joy to the work - we laugh often, celebrate wins big and small, and genuinely enjoy working together. Compensation and Benefits Salary is based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, skill set level and years of previous/applicable experience. Maneva offers a competitive salary along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being of our team. Benefits include employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees; 401K with matching; and generous paid time off policies, including office closure between Christmas and New Years. How to Express Interest To express your interest and explore this opportunity, please submit your resume and cover letter to this application link. All inquiries and discussions will be handled with the utmost confidentiality. This position is available immediately, and applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the role is filled.

Operating across geographic boundaries and time-zones, EC partners with regional and Global Business Line project teams to provide technical expertise, accelerate delivery and keep AECOM competitive in the industry. With a team of over 3000 technical professionals located across nine countries and remote technical anchors, EC teams are trusted to deliver high-quality, specialist services that help to fill capability gaps, resourcing needs and technical constraints on projects of all scopes and sizes. Start here. Grow here. The role acts as the primary interface between ANZ R+I pursuit and project teams and EC delivery teams, driving capability growth, quality project delivery, team development, and business outcomes. The core scope is underground copper and gold hard rock mining and associated industrial infrastructure, weighted towards materials handling: crushing, conveying, transfer stations, ore handling and fixed plant. Here is what you will do: Lead and develop the multidisciplinary engineering and design team. Growing it towards 30+ engineers and designers across civil, structural, mechanical, electrical and project controls as confirmed demand builds. Further develop EC South Africa as a mining and materials handling design centre, building discipline depth and technical standards. Act as a key enabler of ANZ R+I growth by expanding EC participation and workshare opportunities. Build trusted relationships with ANZ business leaders, project managers and global EC stakeholders. Co-ordinate and support EC’s contribution to nominated pursuits. Maintain oversight of technical quality, project delivery, risk and continuous improvement initiatives. Operate as a key relationship manager across international teams, cultures and time zones. Coach and develop team members, strengthen technical and project delivery capability, and create an inclusive, high-performing culture. Identify delivery constraints early and agree corrective actions with the relevant EC and regional leaders. Drive standardisation, digital adoption, lessons learned and continuous improvement across the micro-team. Track and report EC hours, workshare uptake, recruitment progress and delivery performance against the agreed growth plan. Here’s what we’re looking for: Commercially astute and comfortable balancing growth, utilisation, quality, cost and people considerations. An experienced leader of multidisciplinary, multicultural and geographically dispersed teams. Able to build credibility quickly and influence outcomes without relying solely on formal authority. Clear, concise and confident when communicating with senior stakeholders, project teams and technical specialists. Structured and delivery-focused, with the judgement to distinguish between urgent mobilisation needs and longer-term capability building. Proactive in surfacing risks, resolving ambiguity and holding owners to agreed actions. Committed to coaching, inclusion, knowledge transfer and the development of local leadership depth. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering from a recognised institution. 12+ years' experience in engineering consultancy and/or EPCM project delivery in the mining, energy or industrial sectors. Professional Engineer registered with a recognised professional body Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering and design teams within a global delivery environment. At least eight years' formal accountability for people leadership, design management or project delivery performance. Proven technical delivery experience across complex projects. Experience supporting business growth, pursuit planning, workforce planning and operational performance. Underground hard rock mining, materials handling or heavy industrial project experience is advantageous. Prior experience working with Australian project teams, standards or delivery practices is advantageous. Additional Information At AECOM, you will have freedom to grow in a world of opportunity At AECOM, our Freedom to Grow philosophy supports flexibility and balance to help our people thrive. As part of this approach, we ask all hybrid employees to work from an AECOM office at least three days per week. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. About AECOM AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com. What makes AECOM a great place to work You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. new_matches.title: Manager, Digital Infrastructure Development
new_matches.description: About DESRI DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states. At DESRI, our culture is grounded in rigorous analytics and thoughtful risk-taking, with a strong emphasis on creativity, intellectual curiosity, and continuous improvement. We operate with lean teams that prioritize efficiency and minimize unnecessary bureaucracy, enabling individuals to take ownership and move quickly. We value open, constructive dialogue and believe it leads to better outcomes. Above all, we are driven to go the extra mile and support one another, fostering a collaborative environment built on accountability, integrity, and care. About The Role DESRI is seeking a talented and highly motivated Digital Infrastructure Development Manager to join its Development & Origination team. This individual will play a key role in advancing the commercialization and growth of DESRI’s digital infrastructure efforts in addition to our utility-scale solar and battery energy storage portfolio across U.S. power markets. The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment and analytical capabilities with an understanding of project development and the broader data center ecosystem. The role will cover emerging opportunities associated with digital infrastructure and large-load customers, along with related developments of generation/storage projects and grid-supplied power. In addition, the role may cover project and portfolio acquisitions of generation/storage and large load projects. This is a highly cross-functional role that will work closely with colleagues across Development, Investments, M&A, Finance, Legal, and Engineering. What You'll Do The Digital Infrastructure Development Manager will support the commercialization and growth of DESRI’s digital infrastructure and large-load customer development efforts along with the development of it’s solar and battery storage portfolio. Key responsibilities will include: Develop and maintain relationships with digital infrastructure customers, utilities, and related counterparties. Lead project development at sites where large load applications have been filed, working across DESRI to position projects and develop solutions that address customer needs. Work will include management of permitting, real estate acquisition/ minerals/ title, community engagement, transmission interconnection processes, serving as lead on load interconnection applications with the support of internal and external teams, interactions with utility and digital infrastructure customers, and managing development activities to support financing or other monetization of the project. Direct land and site diligence in coordination with internal teams and outside consultants, including water, fiber, and gas supply, title and mineral rights, wetlands and waters delineations, floodplain and hydrology constraints, environmental and cultural resource reviews, and geotechnical findings, and translate diligence results into site layout, schedule, and risk-mitigation decisions. Identify and evaluate opportunities associated with data centers and other large-load customers, including the implications of load growth for generation, storage, transmission, and project development. Support project and portfolio acquisitions, including commercial due diligence, offtake strategy, market analysis, and assessment of merchant and recontracting opportunities. Collaborate closely with Development, Strategy, M&A, Finance, Legal, and Engineering to advance opportunities from initial evaluation through transaction execution. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, engineering, or a related field, with 5 or more years of relevant professional experience in renewable energy, power markets, infrastructure investing, project development, origination, M&A, investment banking, or a related field. Experience with or demonstrated interest in digital infrastructure, large-load customers, and the intersection of power markets and digital infrastructure. Experience with utility-scale renewable energy, with knowledge of solar and battery energy storage project development from project inception to construction/ operation and knowledge of U.S. wholesale power markets strongly preferred. Understanding of renewable energy commercial structures, including power purchase agreements, storage tolling agreements, capacity arrangements, renewable energy credits, hedges, and other forms of project offtake. Strong relationship-building, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to interact effectively with customers, counterparties, senior leadership, and colleagues across functional teams. Ability to travel as needed for customer meetings, conferences, project visits, and transaction activity. At DESRI, we consider a wide range of factors to determine your compensation. We rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, location, skills, and experience. The expected annual base salary for this position is $140,000 - $160,000. Our compensation and benefits package includes variable compensation in the form of a year-end bonus, guaranteed in the first year of hire, and benefits including medical and prescription drug coverage, 401(k) contribution matching, paid time off, wellness reimbursement, family building benefits, and a charitable gift match program.

new_matches.description: Requisition ID: 298458 Relocation Authorized: National/International - Family Telework Type: Full-Time Office/Project Work Location: Cameron, LA, Houston, TX Extraordinary Teams Building Inspiring Projects Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report. Project Overview The Cheniere Sabine Pass Liquefaction (SPL) Project is a Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) export facility located along the Sabine River estuary on the southeastern coast of Cameron Parish, Louisiana. Bulk early work for Stage 1 began at the 1,000+ acre facility in August 2012 and by December 2022, Bechtel had successfully and safely turned over the final phase of Stage 4 to Cheniere. The SPL campus now consists of six operating Trains with an LNG production capacity of approximately 27 million tons per year (MTPA), 3 Jetty superstructures that can accommodate the world’s largest vessels, and dozens of associated buildings and utilities. Sabine Pass Liquefaction Stage 5 Expansion Project (SPL5) is the newest phase at the SPL facility. It will consist of one liquefaction process train with a production capacity of approximately 5 MTPA; one boil-off gas reliquefaction unit; tie-ins to existing storage tanks, ship-loading facilities, and flare systems; and associated utility support infrastructure. SPL5 will perform this work predominantly on a direct hire basis with support from only a few specialty and service subcontractors. The Infrastructure GBU scope consists of installing 9000+ precast concrete driven piles, construction of a new concrete retaining wall, ground improvement works (inc. soil stabilization and wick drains), extension of the existing earthworks platform, construction of a new network of roads, and modifications to the stormwater drainage system. The candidate will act as the Infrastructure Area Manager on the SPL5 Project. The candidate may start in the home office in Houston, TX to support preconstruction planning, ahead of project mobilization to the field when the candidate will locate on a long-term assignment to the project site at Sabine Pass, LA. Job Summary The Infrastructure Area Manager is responsible for managing, coordinating, and administering the Infrastructure GBU scope of works for the project, from the conceptual stages through planning, engineering, procurement, construction and close-out. They will supervise the development of budgets and schedules, manage performance, report progress, and initiate action to assure program/project objectives and schedules are met and work is performed within budget and according to specifications. They will resolve problems and coordinate the final turnover of work to downstream work activities. They will provide leadership for the development and maintenance of a high-performance project team and have overall responsibility for the execution of the Infrastructure GBU scope, ensuring that the works are delivered within contract requirements, standards of quality and safety, and to the Customer and Bechtel performance expectations. Major Responsibilities Oversees the total site management of the Infrastructure GBU scope of works, including supervision of construction craft personnel, field engineering, contract administration, cost and schedule, field procurement, finance and accounting services, and craft resource personnel as applicable. Coordinates project contractual activities and participates in the development of contract, subcontract, or vendor scopes of work, budgets, contract formation, and negotiations Oversees jobsite expenditures for labor equipment, material and services and ensures field operations are within the budget. Follows design development and, where possible, suggests economical construction details to be incorporated into design drawings and specifications. Uses individual knowledge and familiarity with the assigned job as well as past experience, with assistance from the construction support groups, to identify potential problem areas or trends. Reviews and facilitates the logistics plans. Develops supply chain packaging and management plan for the project in collaboration with Engineering, design sub-consultant and Procurement functions Develops field organization and construction equipment plans, with the assistance of the construction support groups. Interfaces with other coordinators and Construction Engineering groups to develop the most economical construction methods and techniques. Establishes project field procedures and objectives within corporate policies and procedures as necessitated by conditions at a jobsite. Participates in the preparation and review of construction cost estimates, budgets, forecasts and schedules. Maintains awareness of any major quantity changes due to design evolution or scope change. Plans and establishes procedures to ensure construction operations meet engineering designs and specifications. Participates in meetings with project team members, other Bechtel entities, and client personnel as required. Ensures that all State and Federal safety codes, requirements, and standards are being complied with. Education And Experience Requirements Requires bachelor's or master's degree (or international equivalent) and 13-15 years of relevant experience or 17-19 years of relevant work experience Required Knowledge And Skills Advanced knowledge of Industry Construction methods and procedures. Extensive experience in managing multi-disciplinary teams (including subconsultant), consisting of geotechnical, civil, structural, seismic, process, mechanical, electrical, environmental, risk engineers in support of project execution. Knowledge and experience in the implementation of ES&H and quality management systems. Good communication and interpersonal skills to maintain a positive work environment between all parties including the client, contractors, and other stakeholders throughout the project life cycle. Self-motivated individual with ability to work independently and exercise professional judgment, with a passion to take ownership of projects and provide sound technical leadership to contractor’s staff and field engineers. new_matches.description: Job Description Background Le Bureau de Coordination des Affaires Humanitaires （OCHA） fait partie du Secrétariat Général des Nations Unies et répond au Secrétaire Général Adjoint chargé des Affaires Humanitaires. En RDC, OCHA a le mandat de la coordination inter agences de l’assistance humanitaire dans des contextes d’urgence complexe ou de désastre naturel, en soutien au Coordonnateur Humanitaire des Nations Unies. Il a la responsabilité spécifique dans la dissémination de l’information destinée à la communauté humanitaire, au Gouvernement de la RDC et aux bailleurs de fonds, ainsi que dans le soutien aux efforts de mobilisation des ressources. Le Bureau de Coordination des Affaires Humanitaires des Nations Unies en République Démocratique du Congo （UNOCHA） a ouvert, dans le cadre de sa stratégie de coordination décentralisée et de proximité, des sous bureaux et antennes humanitaires pour une durée limitée, dans des zones nouvellement accessibles, oubliées ou dans lesquelles des nouvelles dynamiques appellent un renforcement de la coordination, du plaidoyer humanitaire. Ces structures servent de lieux d’échanges entre les ONG, les agences Onusiennes et les autorités, de relais de coordination humanitaire et couvrent une zone géographique déterminée. Aussi, dans le cadre de la riposte contre la maladie à Virus Ebola, OCHA tient à renforcer sa présence dans les zones directement ou indirectement affectées, en vue de faciliter la coordination des actions menées par différents partenaires intervenant dans le domaine. C’est dans ce contexte que cet appel à candidature est lancé. Ces postes sont initialement basés dans les localités indiquées dans l’avis de vacance de poste mais peuvent, à l’avenir et sans préavis, être transférés dans d’autres localités selon les besoins opérationnels de l’Organisation. Duties And Responsibilities Sous la tutelle générale du chef de Bureau OCHA-RDC, la supervision directe de l’Assistant Administratif de la zone et la supervision technique du Chargé de l’Administration et Finances, le chauffeur est chargé de pourvoir des services de conduite fiables et sûrs pour le Bureau OCHA - RDC, tout en faisant preuve d’une très grande discrétion, d’intégrité et de sens de responsabilité, d’une bonne connaissance des principes du protocole et des problèmes de sécurité. Le Chauffeur doit aussi démontrer une approche centrée sur le client, la courtoisie, le tact et la capacité de travailler avec des gens de nationalité et de culture différentes Dans l’exercice de ses fonctions, il （elle） doit être digne de confiance et faire preuve d’une grande discrétion, faisant preuve d’un sens élevé de responsabilité. Conduire le véhicule officiel qui lui est affecté, collecter et distribuer le courrier, les documents et autres articles; effectuer certaines courses auprès des autorités locales et des banques, assurer les accueils des visiteurs officiels （Consultants et Experts en mission) à l’aéroport, faciliter les formalités d’immigration et de douane si nécessaire et assurer leurs déplacements dans le cadre de leurs missions; Être responsable de l’entretien quotidien du véhicule dont il a la charge, contrôler l’huile, l’eau, la batterie, les freins, les pneus, etc.… Effectuer les petites réparations en cas de panne, prendre toutes dispositions pour les importantes réparations et s’assurer que le véhicule qui lui est confié est maintenu propre; Consigner les déplacements officiels, le kilométrage journalier, la consommation de carburant, les contrôles d’huile, les graissages, etc.., dans le Log-Book et tenir à jour la fiche technique du véhicule (les dates de visite technique et de renouvellement de l’assurance); garant de la présence de la trousse de première nécessité et des pièces de rechanges à bord du véhicule; Assurer des réductions des coûts par l'utilisation appropriée de véhicule à travers la maintenance, la tenue quotidienne du carnet de bord et autres dispositions utiles; Fournir un appui logistique à l’organisation des séminaires/ateliers relatifs aux activités du bureau; Veiller à ce que toutes les actions requises par les règlements soient prises en cas d’accident; S’assurer que toutes les formalités prévues par les règlements sont accomplies en cas d’accident; Exécuter toute autre tâche connexe ne dépassant pas ses aptitudes et ses compétences assignées par le Chef de Bureau. Competencies Professionnalisme Connaissance et compréhension des questions d'assistance humanitaire, de secours d'urgence et des questions de droits de l'homme connexes. Connaissance pratique et technique de la maintenance (locaux, véhicules). Aptitude à travailler dans des circonstances contraignantes dans un cadre stressant ; persévérer face aux obstacles et aux difficultés ; savoir rester serein et efficace dans des situations difficiles. Encourager l’égale participation des femmes et des hommes dans toutes les activités. Aptitude à tenir les délais impartis, à respecter le budget convenu et à se tenir aux normes ; se conformer aux règles et procédures de l’Organisation. Esprit D’équipe Collaborer avec ses collègues afin d’atteindre les objectifs de l'Organisation; solliciter les apports, apprécier à leur juste valeur les idées et la compétence de chacun; être disposé à apprendre d’autrui; aptitude à faire passer l’intérêt de l’équipe avant son avantage personnel; aptitude à accepter les décisions finales du groupe et s’y plier, même si elles ne cadrent pas parfaitement avec sa position propre; aptitude à partager les réussites de l’équipe et assumer sa part de responsabilité dans ses échecs. Aptitude à Planifier Et à Organiser Aptitude à hiérarchiser les activités et tâches prioritaires et réaménager les priorités en fonction des besoins ; aptitude à prévoir suffisamment de temps et de ressources pour mener sa tâche à bien ; aptitude à tenir compte des risques et des imprévus dans la planification ; aptitude à suivre l’exécution des plans et des mesures et les modifier s’il y a lieu ; aptitude à tirer le meilleur parti du temps dont on dispose. Souci Du Client Aptitude à voir des projets ;s » en tous les destinataires de services et chercher à voir les choses de leur point de vue; aptitude à établir et entretenir des partenariats productifs avec les clients en gagnant leur confiance et leur respect; aptitude à discerner les besoins des clients et y répondre; aptitude à suivre l'évolution de la situation des clients, sur les plans tant intérieur qu'extérieur, afin d'anticiper les problèmes; aptitude à tenir les clients informés de l'avancement des projets; aptitude à tenir les délais de livraison des produits ou de prestation des services. Education Required Skills and Experience Minimum une formation post primaire. Un diplôme d’état en Mécanique et/ou un Brevet en automobile serait un atout considérable. Experience Une expérience professionnelle relevante d’au moins deux ans acquise en tant que Chauffeur avec un bon passé de conduite prudente est requise ; la connaissance des règles de la bonne conduite et aptitude pour les petites réparations requises. Une expérience professionnelle d’au deux ans au sein du Système des Nations Unies, particulièrement avec OCHA, ou ONG Internationale souhaitée, La maitrise du lieu d’affectation (Est de la RDC) est un avantage, savoir conduite des véhicules blindés est souhaité. Etre détenteur d’un permis de conduire valide requis ; Avoir la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en équipe ; Avoir la capacité de travailler dans un environnement multiethnique, multiracial et multiculturel ; Etre capable de travailler sous stress dans des situations instables ; Etre apte à conduire des petites réparations et superviser les grosses réparations dans les garages agrées ; Justifier des connaissances en informatique (bureautique). Connaissances linguistiques : L’anglais et le français sont les langues de travail du Secrétariat des Nations Unies. Pour le poste publié, la maîtrise du français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, est requise. La connaissance de l’anglais et/ou d’une autre langue officielle des Nations Unies est atout. La connaissance des langues locales constitue un avantage. Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority OCHA applique une politique de tolérance zéro contre les cas d’exploitation sexuelle, abus sexuels et du harcèlement sexuel. Selon la Circulaire du Secrétaire général ST/SGB/2003/13, l’expression « exploitation sexuelle » désigne le fait d’abuser ou de tenter d’abuser d’un état de vulnérabilité, d’un rapport de force inégal ou de rapports de confiance à des fins sexuelles, y compris mais non exclusivement en vue d’en tirer un avantage pécuniaire, social ou politique. On entend par « abus sexuel » toute atteinte sexuelle commise avec force, contrainte ou à la faveur d’un rapport inégal, la menace d’une telle atteinte constituant aussi l’abus sexuel. Le « harcèlement sexuel » implique toute avance sexuelle non souhaitée, toute demande de faveur sexuelle, toute conduite verbale ou physique ou tout geste de nature sexuelle, ou tout autre comportement de nature sexuelle auquel on pourrait raisonnablement s'attendre ou sembler choquer ou humilier. Le harcèlement sexuel peut se produire lorsqu'il interfère avec le travail, devient une condition d'emploi ou crée un environnement intimidant, hostile ou offensant. Right to select multiple candidates UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements. Use of AI by candidates Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection Scam alert UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam-alert.
